topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I just found out my favorite place to eat is shutting its doors. It’s been there for as long as I can remember, the same warm lights, the same comforting smell of fresh bread and roasted garlic. I used to go there for every special occasion, and even on the days I just needed a bit of normalcy. Now, I guess I’ll have to find a new spot, but it won’t be the same. The thought of not being able to sit in my usual corner, not hearing the familiar hum of the kitchen, it’s a bit overwhelming. I keep hoping it’s just a rumor, but deep down, I know it’s real.
